Archive utility 7z.exe created RND-Q2-prototype.zip from a project workspace shortly before outbound transfer.

DLP recorded the encrypted outbound transfer size but could not inspect the archive contents.
The same workstation resolved api.files-sync-share.net, a sibling domain on the same storage edge.
A follow-on TLS session used the sibling API domain after the large upload completed.
A second R&D workstation briefly connected to the same storage edge, but only once and without host corroboration.
